description_en: Modifies the auto-renewal attributes of one or more elasticity assurances
description_zh: 修改一个或多个弹性保障服务的自动续费属性
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-elasticity-assurance-auto-renew-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --period 1 --period-unit Month --renewal-status Normal --private-pool-options-id eap-bp1bgwq0gqeukw1l0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyElasticityAssuranceAutoRenewAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the elasticity assurance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 弹性保障服务所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal period.

If PeriodUnit is set to Year, valid values are 1, 3, and 5.

If PeriodUnit is set to Month, valid value is 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
设置实例自动续费时长。



当`PeriodUnit`为`Year`时，取值范围：1、3、5。

当`PeriodUnit`为`Month`时，取值范围：1。




默认值：1
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the renewal period. Valid values:

Month

Year

Default value: Month
parameters.help_zh:
续费时长的单位。取值范围：

Month：月

Year：年

默认值：Month
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal status of the instance. Valid values:

AutoRenewal: enables auto-renewal.

Normal: disables auto-renewal.

NotRenewal: does not renew the instance. If you set this parameter to NotRenewal, the system no longer sends expiration reminders, but sends a non-renewal reminder three days before expiration. You can change the status of an elasticity assurance that is not to be renewed to Normal, and then manually renew it or enable auto-renewal
parameters.help_zh:
实例的自动续费状态。取值范围：

AutoRenewal：设置为自动续费。

Normal：取消自动续费。

NotRenewal：不再续费。传入该值后，系统不再发送到期提醒，只在到期前第三天发送不续费提醒。不再续费的弹性保障服务可以更改成待续费（`Normal`）后，再自行续费或设置为自动续费
parameters.name: renewal_status

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the elasticity assurances to be modified. This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the MissingParameter.PrivatePoolOptionsId error is returned.

You can modify the auto-renewal settings of up to 50 elasticity assurances at a time
parameters.help_zh:
待修改的弹性保障服务ID列表。此参数为必填项，未提供时接口返回 MissingParameter.PrivatePoolOptionsId。

单次修改的弹性保障服务数量最多不超过 50 个
parameters.name: private_pool_options_id
